headings.strategy: The Anti-Default Rule: Never use Inter for headings. Use fluid typography with tight tracking (tracking-tighter) for large headings.

scales.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter leading-none font-bold

body.strategy: Geometric Sans for legibility and modern SaaS feel.

colors.strategy: Deep Obsidian background with high-contrast text. Accent colors used strictly for action (Electric Blaze/Amber) to give a human, energetic touch to the testimonial product.

glassmorphism.implementation: bg-black/60 backdrop-blur-xl border border-white/10 shadow-[0_8px_32px_rgba(0,0,0,0.12)] (Dark Mode). Ensure text has high contrast. NEVER use pure transparent background.

grid_borders.implementation: border-collapse layout with 1px subtle borders (border-border/40). Flat, cardless appearance.

tracing_beam.implementation: Animated gradient border that traces the edge using Framer Motion or CSS mask-image.

marketing_pages.strategy: The Bento/Tetris Grid Protocol. High visual tension, asymmetrical.
marketing_pages.implementation: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-8. Mix spans (e.g., col-span-8 row-span-2 for hero widget preview, col-span-4 for supporting text). Use generous padding (p-12 to p-24) for sections.

dashboard_admin.strategy: High Density Grid. Information clarity over decoration.
dashboard_admin.implementation: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-4 or gap-6. Compact spacing. Left-aligned task-oriented interfaces.

grids_and_layouts.spacing_scale: Use 2-3x more spacing. Containers with borders MUST have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent collision.

component_strategies.marketing_ui: Use raw HTML/Tailwind for unique layouts. Do not use standard Shadcn cards here to avoid the generic SaaS look.
component_strategies.dashboard_ui: Use Shadcn components heavily customized (flat, 1px border, dense). No heavy shadows in dark mode.

testimonial_widgets.masonry_wall: Columns using CSS column-count or responsive grid for 'Wall of Love'.
testimonial_widgets.marquee: Infinite horizontal scroll (react-fast-marquee) for displaying dense client feedback.
testimonial_widgets.cards: Include verified badge, avatar, name, handle, company logo, and specific metrics in the quote.

component_strategies.data_visualization: Use Shadcn/Recharts for analytics (views, conversion). Minimalist, monochromatic with primary accent.
component_strategies.icons: Use lucide-react (already installed). Phosphor Icons recommended for dense dashboards if installing another.
component_strategies.forms: Public submission form must be mobile-first. Huge record button, floating glassmorphism card over a dark gradient or abstract background.

rules: Staggered entrance for list items/widgets using framer-motion.
Hover states must be explicitly defined for text (hover:text-white).

instructions_to_main_agent: CRITICAL: Read this JSON file completely before starting.
CRITICAL: DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for nav/headers. Use backdrop-blur and semi-transparent colors.
Do not center align paragraphs or app layout (.App). Left align dense content and forms.
Use data-testid attributes for ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='submit-testimonial-btn').
Install required dependencies: framer-motion, react-fast-marquee, lucide-react, sonner.
Implement Sonner for toast notifications (e.g., 'Testimonial Approved').
Create a toggle for Dark/Light mode in the dashboard setting, but default to Dark Mode for the landing page.
For the Widget Builder, create a Live Preview pane that takes up 60% of the screen, and controls on the left sidebar (40%).
Empty States should not be blank - add onboarding steps like 'Share your first collection link'.
universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖🧠💭) for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Use the exact provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder text/URLs.
